Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Orchestrator proposed an “optimal strategy” that sets each guess equal to the minimum of the actual hidden box counts for a given distribution. This incorrectly assumes Bob knows the true distribution and tailors his guesses to it. The correct problem requires a single set of guesses chosen without knowledge of the distribution or order, maximizing the minimum winnings over all valid configurations. By optimizing per-distribution and then taking a minimum, the Orchestrator modeled the game incorrectly, leading to the erroneous $3,000 result.
